title: A token bucket
description:
Limit how fast your client sends requests.

```
capacity 3, refill 1 per second
t=0.0 send, send, send, wait 1.00 s
t=1.0 send
t=1.5 wait 0.50 s
```
hints: First refill: `self.tokens = min(self.capacity, self.tokens + (now - self.last) * self.rate)` and set `self.last = now` (lesson 3.02).
With at least one token, take it and return 0; otherwise return `(1 - self.tokens) / self.rate`.
requirements: `class TokenBucket(capacity, rate)` with `take(now)` returning 0 when a request may go, or the number of seconds to wait.
Tokens refill continuously at `rate` per second, never above the capacity.
Pass `now` in, so it can be tested without sleeping.
stretch: Read `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers and slow down when the server says so.
